notes.title: Update – August 6th, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]📅 [b]Patch Note – August 6th, 2025[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]A maintenance was performed today to bring several improvements and fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a summary of the changes:[/p][p]🔍 [b]New Content[/b]
  Police Missions are now available until the end of September.[/p][p]🧩 [b]User Experience Improvements[/b]
  The order of your missions is now saved after restarting the game.[/p][p]🌍 [b]Localization[/b]
  Several translation errors in the interface and dialogues have been corrected.[/p][p]🧙‍♀️ [b]Pyramid & Random Items[/b]
  Fixed random rewards related to the Pyramid and other events.
  → [i]No more Witch Collections invading your valleys by mistake!
[/i]
  🔧 The XP value of some shop items has been adjusted.
[/p][p]🖥️ [b]Display[/b]
  Resolution adjustments for better compatibility with 2560px+ screens.
  Various minor bugs have also been fixed.

 💖 Several bugs have been fixed. 
[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support, and see you soon in your valleys! 💛[/p]

notes.title: Update: 60 FPS & Faster Animations!
